name: Sister tyranT ~Jitsu Ane Kuppuku Choukyou~
source:
Ryo is a sheepish boy and younger brother of beautiful and inteligent girl Iori. He is bullied by Iori almost everyday, hating her so much. One day, he finds a diary of Iori in her room. From what is written in the diary, Ryo learns she has a desire to be humiliated.....

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE024619.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
凉是一个害羞的男孩，也是美丽聪明的女孩伊织的弟弟。他几乎每天都被伊织欺负，非常讨厌她。有一天，他在伊织的房间里发现了一本日记。从日记中所写的内容中，凉得知她有一种被羞辱的愿望……

[来自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE024619.html]dlsite[/url]]
